qa_coverage.required_evidence: Decode actual file; correct dimensions, MIME, file size and source hash.
Useful transparent surround and visible subject; no opaque rectangle or all-transparent output.
No halo, missing fine parts, baked checkerboard, clipped subject or edge contamination.
Source/rights and generation/repair lineage within approved scope.
Correct meaning, subject and status; no misleading proof.
No unintended lettering, third-party marks or stray content.
Matches approved geometry, perspective, material, palette, lighting, detail and shadow.
Works with accepted family at required scales/surfaces without style conflict.
Primary message, focal point, reading order and action are clear.
Alignment, whitespace, visual weight and text/image balance work at actual size.
Readable text/contrast/alternatives; scoped manual review; full website accessibility remains implementation work.
Required resize/crop/recompose/replacement cases work.
Independent layers, pivots, light/geometry continuity, timing and caption/source clearance work.
Correct file/page, ordered accepted assets, actual result IDs and reconciled counts.
Preserved transparency, bounds, fit, parenting, no clipping/overlap.
Native container sizing, wrapping, stacking and instances work.
Frozen category/variant/template requirements accounted for; no missing/extra/duplicate records.
